name: floating-dock-bar
title: Floating Dock Bar
description: An elevated floating application launcher shelf with icon buttons, tooltips, and blur backdrop.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Floating Dock Navigation: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
